name: OpenAI API Key
remediation: Revoke the key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys and use environment variables.

name: Anthropic API Key
remediation: Revoke at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.

name: Hugging Face Token
remediation: Revoke at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.

name: AWS Access Key
remediation: Deactivate in AWS IAM console immediately.

name: AWS Secret Key
remediation: Rotate root or IAM credentials in AWS console.

name: GitHub Token
remediation: Revoke at https://github.com/settings/tokens.

name: Google Cloud API Key
remediation: Restrict or delete key at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials.

name: Supabase Key
remediation: Rotate key in Supabase Project Settings > API.

name: Firebase API Key
remediation: Rotate in Firebase Console > Project Settings > Cloud Messaging.

name: Vercel Token
remediation: Revoke at https://vercel.com/account/tokens.

name: Stripe Restricted Key
remediation: Revoke in Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API keys.

name: Slack Webhook URL
remediation: Delete the webhook in Slack Apps configuration.

name: Twilio Account SID
remediation: Check for associated Auth Token leaks.

name: Discord Bot Token
remediation: Reset token in Discord Developer Portal.

name: Database Connection String
remediation: Change database password immediately.

name: Private Key
remediation: Revoke the key and generate a new one. Do not reuse.

name: JWT Secret (Literal)
remediation: Use a complex secret stored in env variables.

name: LINE Channel Secret
remediation: Issue a new secret in LINE Developers Console.

name: ECPAY HashKey
remediation: Update HashKey in ECPAY vendor dashboard.

name: Generic Secret Key
remediation: Review the usage and move to secure secrets management.

name: Cohere API Key
remediation: Revoke at https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys.

name: Replicate API Token
remediation: Revoke at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens.

name: Azure Connection String
remediation: Rotate Storage Account keys in Azure Portal.

name: Netlify Access Token
remediation: Revoke at https://app.netlify.com/user/settings/applications.

name: GCP Service Account
remediation: Delete the key in GCP IAM console and use Workload Identity Federation.

name: PayPal Secret
remediation: Revoke in PayPal Developer Dashboard > Apps & Credentials.

name: Square Access Token
remediation: Revoke in Square Developer Dashboard.

name: SendGrid API Key
remediation: Revoke at https://app.sendgrid.com/settings/api_keys.

name: PlanetScale Password
remediation: Rotate password in PlanetScale branch settings.

name: Auth0 Client Secret
remediation: Rotate secret in Auth0 Dashboard > Applications.

name: Clerk Secret Key
remediation: Revoke in Clerk Dashboard > API Keys.
